{{Quote|The Empire has collected many sliideptra for use in experiments and research concerning chemical warfare. Their research produced the paralytic grain mold that decimated Keresia,'' [&hellip;]''<nowiki></nowiki>|Holobrochure for the Tagge Holographic Museum of Chandrila|<ref name="Creatures">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>}}
'''Keresia''' was an astronomical object<ref name="Creatures" /> located within the [[Keresia system/Legends|Keresia system]], a part of the [[Demetras sector/Legends|Demetras sector]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" />

When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used the [[sliideptra]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[annelid]]ians [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to [[Tel IV]]<ref name="Creatures" /> in the [[Halthor sector/Legends|Halthor sector]],<ref name="EAOC Tel">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}&mdash;Based on corresponding data for [[Tel system/Legends|Tel system]]</ref> to research chemical weapons, their experiments led to the creation of a paralytic grain mold that decimated Keresia. The latter celestial body's fate was mentioned in a [[Holo-brochure|holobrochure]] for the [[Tagge Holographic Museum]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].<ref name="Creatures" />

==Behind the scenes==
Keresia was first mentioned in ''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]'', a [[1994]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook published by [[West End Games]].<ref name="Creatures" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Keresia [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body Keresia, within grid square P-7.<ref name="TEA" />
